title: Six to Ten, and the Change That Happened Next Door
label: ch:ur-count-ten
canDo: I can count aloud from one to ten in Urdu, and explain why Persian says haft where Urdu says sat.

payoff.summary: Five more numbers with no new letter, the Iranian s-to-h change seen from the side that did not undergo it, and the whole run of ten shuffled.
